title: Remake Threat Intelligence on the standard front end
description:
Dependencies: Papyrus initiative PPY-25ffa3 (draft board branch board/standard-frontend-plan): the core preset (PPY-cf7e6e), brand pack (PPY-88a883), native tokens (PPY-2a44b2), one ordering rule (PPY-c446fe). Related existing: PPY-332889 and PPY-386123 (TI onto the CMS app shell; separate from the public layout).
What: Threat Intelligence goes first onto the standard publication layout and ends up just like Machines on Machines with a different editorial focus and brand. It runs with no site hooks. It may drop animated pictograms (hard to maintain) and keep still pictograms through the image-style slot (PPY-1f68bf).
Done when: TI builds and passes the shared Gherkin suite with zero TI Python or CSS beyond the brand pack, no Machines on Machines file changed, and every live URL still resolves.
